scope: Post-completion parity polish and public-contract closure for Bedrock Wither goals, integration semantics, movement turn limit and pushability; no empirical Bedrock/Tank parity claim
changes: Register look_at_target priority 5 and look_at_player priority 6 with public defaults look_distance 8 and probability 0.02 plus Wither look_time 20..40 ticks
Bridge independent Monster kill credit to vanilla-equivalent Wither Rose placement/drop semantics
Expose Wither ambient/hurt/death SoundEvents and Java Wither level-event sound bridges: break 1022, spawn 1023, shoot 1024
Add four focused Forge GameTests for the supplemented contracts
Replace Java FlyingMoveControl yaw-90 limitation with BedrockFlyingMoveControl applying public movement.basic max_turn=180 to yaw and pitch
Preserve minecraft:pushable_by_entity while on climbable blocks instead of inheriting LivingEntity's climb-time push suppression
Add two focused Forge GameTests for the 180-degree turn contract and simultaneous can_climb/pushable_by_entity/pushable_by_block behavior

red_green.failure: BedrockLookGoal used EntitySelector.notRiding(owner) directly where TargetingConditions selector required Predicate<LivingEntity>
red_green.repair: Wrap notRiding in an explicitly typed LivingEntity lambda

limits: Sound bridges use Java 1.20.1 Wither SoundEvents/level events; exact Bedrock audio asset mix, attenuation and timing were not measured
Look goal scheduling is a Java Goal adaptation of the public Bedrock component contract, not hidden-native implementation recovery
Wither Rose handling mirrors Java integration semantics needed because the product intentionally does not inherit WitherBoss
Reposition/path generation, cadence, dash, transition, reflection and death historical/Java-adapter limits remain; the separate public max_turn yaw mismatch is now closed
No live Bedrock client/server or Tank comparison was performed
